metadata.name: The Spillway
metadata.description: A hydroelectric dam across a mountain gorge. Fight along the crest 28 m over the valley, up and down the two stair towers on the dam's face, round the powerhouse at its foot, and across the river running out below. Embers hold the west bench by the loading dock, Tide the south-east bench; the east bench and its bunker look down on both.
